title: Danny and the Leaf Inside the Stone
synopsis: Danny finds the shape of a fern in an old fossil stone and goes looking for the same branching shape on a living leaf.

related_resources.reason: Fern fossils can preserve impressions or remains of plant structures in rock; the story uses a labeled museum fossil to avoid guessing from a random mark.
